subject: READY FOR REVIEW: integration suite 534 checks; 3 distinct bridge blockers named
body:
integration_tests deliverable is ready for root review (not production/hardware approval).

Files: new gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py (owned path); worker helpers gpu/build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/integration_tests/{abi_oracle.py,tgp2_contract_test.c,n2mb_v2_job_test.c,n2mb_v9_golden.c,producer_plan_test.py,STATUS.md}. Main test resolves helpers from worker dir or gpu/tests[/support], so root can copy them next to the test. No production edit, no commit/device/native build/publish.

Latest run against bridge.c 52f00fec..., pipeline_format.h dfc0a410..., air_bridge.rs f83ed62f..., runtime_pipeline.inc 5c9c46dc..., Rust cdylib 4bad3821...: 534 checks (release+ASan), 3 distinct required failures, 0 pending; ABI PASS; producer 47/47; no sanitizer finding.

Green coverage: generated C/Rust ABI (resource160/descriptor64/region1172/v2 11496, every field size/offset), full TGP2 parser matrix including reserved_view/domain/declared-combined/compare/atomic/SRT, COMPUTE_JOB byte-equal to v1 emitters, SHADER_PROGRAM codeVA/preload/register, LOCAL_STORAGE, FAU with Metal30->native1, SRT base+count4, table1[N]/table2[N], combined5/Metal9 and combined1 producer shape, image table1[4], read-only image write mask, dummy2[256], 2-layer planes, sparse sampler255/Metal0, IO surface plane address, v1 byte regression, buffer-only v2, nonzero UBO range, exact-thread 17x9 regions, bad/null/span/offset/format/Vk-view/undeclared-binding/token/mode refusals with unchanged outputs, real Rust planner descriptor/region/specialization checks, arch9 v9_pack golden (texture/sampler/plane words0..6) and v10 golden.

Three distinct required gaps (all owner compute/nord2_metal_bridge.c, full minimal repros in messages 1792944250323360290 and 1792944408061639261): (1) combined sampler_index=99 accepted; (2) declared wire span 1 byte short still authorizes the full 1024-byte layout because n2t gets the whole remaining BO; (3) nonzero wire swizzle 0x210 silently becomes identity 0x688 because l.swizzle_valid is never set. These are gated as required failures and counted in the report, not skipped.

Explicit limitations: tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 still absent so real compiler cannot emit TGP2; transport refuses levels>1 (explicit coverage outcome); view_level/layer informational; no lod_bias in compute resource/wire; frontend object lifetime/render hook not in this suite; no GPU/pixel/IOSurface-coherence claim. I will rerun after bridge changes and refresh report/STATUS.
